violations.text: Clean equipment and utensils stored in a room that is not fully enclosed (open to outdoors/screened).

Food being prepared in a room that has screening in place of all or part of a wall.
Rice cooker in screened in room attached to food truck

Mobile food dispensing vehicle connected to utilities on more than a temporary basis.
Waste tank and natural gas tank in the ground with permanent hook up. Water line and gas line was disconnected at time of inspection.

Screened room is attached to permanent building/bar leading to food truck where it is connected to exterior of food truck. POS system and menu is located inside bar for customers to dine in and order from menu.

Establishment operating with changed menu and/or increased seating without septic system approval for such change.
Bar that is connected to food truck has 80 seats. And 20 seats outside . Total of 100 seats on well.
